'''Virtual Legacy''' — [[You May Start Your Landing (V)]] (1282_3) |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Dark Effect: You May Start Your Landing, Tatooine, R |strategy=By Andrew Parkshttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/youmaystartyourlanding.html This card heralds the return of the almighty [[Walker Garrison]] deck. Being able to start this effect with [[Prepared Defenses]] is a great boost to this classic deck type. On your first turn, you can immediately go and grab the [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark){{!}}3rd Marker]], which combined with the [[Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker){{!}}5th Marker]] gives you 4 red icons and a +1 Force Drain location, while the Light Side only gets one blue icon from you in the bargain. Plus, you are guaranteed to have a [[Walker Garrison]] in hand right from the get-go, so you are all set to drain like mad once you've got all your Walkers in position. The best part of this card, however, is its ability to deal direct damage just by occupying [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] marker sites with AT-ATs, which any self-respecting [[Walker Garrison]] deck has in abundance. If you choose [[No Escape]] as one of your starting effects, this direct damage will not be cancelled by Honor of the Jedi, which is a good thing since your force drains at non-battlegrounds will be negated by that powerful Light Side card. Be sure to pack a couple Presence of the Force to help turn those Marker Sites into battlegrounds and add to your drains in the bargain. For a third starting effect for this deck type, you probably want to start with [[Imperial Arrest Order]]. This will give a big boost to all your Walker pilots, and allow you to deploy the [[Hoth: Echo Docking Bay (Dark){{!}}Hoth: Echo Docking Bay]] right away, a great place to plop a Walker to help drain with [[Walker Garrison]]. Unfortunately, the [[Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay){{!}}Docking Bay]] isn't a Marker Site, but it's still a great battleground to drain at with your Walkers. An alternative starting effect is [[Imperial Decree]], which is pretty easy to keep active with this deck and which can really hurt those cowardly Rebels. |pulled_by=* [[Twi'lek Advisor]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=You%20May%20Start%20Your%20Landing Scomp: You May Start Your Landing]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive] * [[We Must Accelerate Our Plans]] |pulls=* [[Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker) (Dark){{!}}Hoth: Defensive Perimeter]] * [[Walker Garrison]] * [[Walker Garrison (V)]] |also_known_as=* YMSYL |has_refs=1 }}
